zh.title: 介绍你最近在做的一件事
zh.prompt: 向一位不了解情况的同事介绍你最近在做的事。
zh.hint: 背景 → 做了什么 → 下一步

zh.title: 用 1 分钟做自我介绍
zh.prompt: 假设你在面试开场，面试官请你做自我介绍。
zh.hint: 我是谁 → 做过什么 → 为什么适合

zh.title: 向外行解释一个你熟悉的概念
zh.prompt: 向一位完全不懂的朋友解释一个你领域里的概念。
zh.hint: 一句话定义 → 打个比方 → 举个例子

zh.title: 说说你对远程办公的看法
zh.prompt: 在讨论会上表达你的观点并给出理由。
zh.hint: 观点 → 两个理由 → 总结

zh.title: 汇报本周的工作进展
zh.prompt: 在周会上向负责人汇报本周进展。
zh.hint: 结论 → 完成了什么 → 风险与需要的支持

en.title: Describe something you've been working on
en.prompt: Explain what you've been working on lately to a colleague who has no context.
en.hint: Background → What you did → Next steps

en.title: Introduce yourself in one minute
en.prompt: You're at the start of an interview and the interviewer asks you to introduce yourself.
en.hint: Who you are → What you've done → Why you fit

en.title: Explain a concept you know well to a layperson
en.prompt: Explain a concept from your field to a friend with no background in it.

en.title: Share your view on remote work
en.prompt: State your position in a discussion and back it up with reasons.

en.title: Report this week's progress
en.prompt: Update your manager on this week's progress at the weekly meeting.
en.hint: Bottom line → What's done → Risks and support needed
